messages.content: Find the top rated modern sculpture exhibition happening in New York in the upcoming month.

function.name: card_game_probability_calculate
function.description: Calculate the probability of drawing a certain card or suit from a deck of cards. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

total_cards.description: Total number of cards in the deck.

function.name: find_exhibition
function.description: Locate the most popular exhibitions based on criteria like location, time, art form, and user ratings. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where the exhibition is held, e.g., New York, NY.

art_form.description: The form of art the exhibition is displaying e.g., sculpture.

month.description: The month of exhibition. Default value will return upcoming events.

user_ratings.description: Select exhibitions with user rating threshold. Default is 'high'

function.name: get_sculpture_info
function.description: Retrieves the most recent artwork by a specified artist with its detailed description. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of the sculpture. This is optional. Default 2024

detail.description: If True, it provides detailed description of the sculpture. Defaults to False.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to locate the most popular exhibitions based on criteria including location (New York), art form (sculpture presumably), month (upcoming). They want top-rated modern sculpture exhibition.

We have tool `find_exhibition` which can search exhibitions given location, art_form, month?, user_ratings? It returns something. We need to call this function.

Thus we should use find_exhibition with location="New York", art_form="modern sculpture"? But the parameter expects art_form as string; maybe just "sculpture". For month unspecified means upcoming events. User ratings high. So:

{
    location:"New York",
    art_form:"sculpture",
    user_ratings:"high"
}

But they specifically ask for modern sculpture exhibition. Maybe specify art_form="modern sculpture".

Let's do that. We'll set month omitted so defaults to upcoming. Use user_ratings="high". Let's call the function.
